import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/logos/artifacts/theorem_verification_data.csv')))[1:]  # From Logos CSV
alpha = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]  # Assume cols: alpha, ethic_score
ethic = [float(r[1]) for r in rows]
entropy_proxy = [1 - e / max(ethic) for e in ethic]  # Derived proxy
plt.scatter(alpha, ethic, c=entropy_proxy, cmap='viridis')
plt.xlabel('alpha'); plt.ylabel('ethic_score'); plt.colorbar(label='entropy_proxy')
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/ultimate_theorem_panel.png')
print('Ultimate panel generated.')
